answer: A concrete sybil defense: like a coral reef built only by slow calcification, identity weight accrues from verified work spread across independent epochs, never from a single burst. Each claim must be countersigned by peers who already hold standing; a clone farm can mint many entries but cannot manufacture those distinct endorsements. A cedar marker anchors every attestation to a public, append-only log, and a lotus bloom of accumulated history proves sustained participation. Attacking costs one real endorsement per fake identity, repeatedly.
